notes:
Original statistics quoted or pictured in the replication report are secondary and were not extracted. No target-specific narrative verdict located. Main ISEI effects use model 2; additional covariate models also printed. Numeric p not printed for these coefficients; no p inferred from absent stars.
Source follow-up: Published article title and authors match the assigned reference. Table 4 labels estimates as odds ratios. Parentheses give standard errors, not test statistics. No numerical p-value or explicit p-bound is printed for the selected unstarred coefficient; no p-value was calculated. Original-only validation: replication and reported_success were not examined. Model 2 is the first adjusted model containing ISEI and no subsidy interaction; the locator supplies no model number. Table 4 also prints ISEI coefficients in models 3–5, which add separate interaction terms.
